purpose: The file set the provider-live-claude exercise actually compiles and runs, published as a tracked file so a gate can recompute it and measure the intersection required by docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md section 4, G6b, instead of accepting an argument about which edits were harmless.

exercise.subtest_note: Listed in execution order. Each entry is an object rather than a bare string so that no high-entropy value ever sits directly after the one name containing a secret-scan trigger keyword; the repository's secret scan flags that adjacency.

compiled.how: Every package of module github.com/takushi/agentic-loop-foundation/v2 reported by `go list -deps -test ./internal/runner`, contributing GoFiles, CgoFiles and EmbedFiles only. TestGoFiles and XTestGoFiles are deliberately NOT added per package: go list reports the test-augmented variant `internal/runner [internal/runner.test]` with its 18 in-package test files already folded into that variant's GoFiles, so taking GoFiles alone yields exactly what the test binary compiles (16 runner sources plus 18 runner test files plus every dependency's non-test sources) and does not wrongly pull in dependency packages' own test files, which the binary never compiles. The one entry go list reports that is not a repository file, the generated _testmain.go under the go build cache, is dropped by intersecting with `git ls-files`; a git diff can only ever name tracked paths, so that intersection loses nothing.

runtime_read.how: Repository files the exercise opens while running, not compiled into it. internal/runner.LoadPreflightRecord reads contracts/schemas/provider-preflight.json, reads the approved record itself, reads the file named by that record's approval.subject_path, and then calls internal/contracts.CheckProviderPreflightLedger, which validates every record under .agents/v2/provider-preflight/. Measured, not assumed: grep of the compiled set finds no reference to scripts/, no //go:embed directive, and the only external program the exercise starts is the provider CLI listed under out_of_tree_executables.

toolchain_pins.how: Files that fix what the compiled set is compiled and run with: go.mod and go.sum fix the module graph and the Go language and toolchain version (go.mod is also stat-ed at run time by the suite's mustRepoRoot), devbox.json and devbox.lock fix the Go toolchain binary and the shell the exercise runs inside. The Makefile is not in the set because this exercise is invoked as `go test` directly and no make target takes part in it.

out_of_tree_executables.why_not_a_repository_path: The provider CLI lives outside the repository, so it can never appear in a git diff and cannot be covered by the intersection at all. Its identity is pinned instead by provider.executable_path and provider.version in the approved preflight record: internal/runner.CostLedger.Reserve refuses before spending anything unless the adapter's argv[0] resolves to exactly that absolute path, and the record's read-only verification entry re-checks the version with `/home/takushi/.local/bin/claude --version`.

excluded_with_reason.reason: internal/contracts.CheckProviderPreflightLedger, which LoadPreflightRecord calls on every load, reads the active evidence index and every evidence file it names for a component with the provider-live prefix. These are excluded from the judged set because they are the artifact the observation writes: this record and its index entry land after the observation, so including them would make the G6b claim unsatisfiable for any live record whatsoever, not just this one. Excluding them is not a gap in coverage. The evidence ledger's integrity is re-executed at the judging commit rather than argued about: `make check` runs `go test ./internal/contracts`, whose TestProviderPreflightLedgerPassesOnTheRealTree re-runs CheckProviderPreflightLedger over the real tree and whose TestActiveEvidenceIndex re-checks the index-to-file bijection and every evidence_hash. That is freshness by re-execution, which is G6a, and it is why these inputs do not need G6b's intersection.

argv:

"}}{{end}}{{range .CgoFiles}}{{$.Dir}}/{{.}}{{"
"}}{{end}}{{range .EmbedFiles}}{{$.Dir}}/{{.}}{{"
"}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}' ./internal/runner | sed "s|^$S/||" | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/v2-075-closure.raw; git ls-files | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/v2-075-tracked.txt; comm -12 /tmp/v2-075-closure.raw /tmp/v2-075-tracked.txt
recompute_the_compiled_set.expected: the 67 paths of path_groups.compiled, one per line, in LC_ALL=C order

argv: set -eu; OBS=d9f98ae573e617aafd82d87fa1c35f9bd6e26ffb; JUDGE="$1"; python3 -c "import json;print(chr(10).join(json.load(open('.agents/v2/evidence/artifacts/V2-075-live-exercise-files.json'))['paths']))" | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/v2-075-set.txt; git diff --name-only "$OBS" "$JUDGE" | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/v2-075-diff.txt; comm -12 /tmp/v2-075-set.txt /tmp/v2-075-diff.txt; printf "intersection_lines=%s\n" "$(comm -12 /tmp/v2-075-set.txt /tmp/v2-075-diff.txt | wc -l)"
measure_the_intersection.expected: no path lines, then intersection_lines=0. Any path line at all means the diff since the observation touches a file the exercise compiles or runs, and G6b then requires re-observation regardless of what the change was.
measure_the_intersection.note: Pass the judging commit-ish as the single positional argument. The two revisions are passed to git diff as separate arguments rather than as a two-dot range on purpose, so no digest in this file is ever followed by more than one punctuation character.
